svg.title: F126.5.1 the guide's evals: where it lives and runs

g.text: F126.5.1 the guide's evals: where it lives and runs
the eval routes and the run work
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: The guide's eval file is read by the site's API, whose run work plays it against the
guide over the sessions API and records each play; the first repeats go into git, where
the replay test plays them with no key. The number in brackets is the step.
